children: Hong Kong conglomerate's interim revenue fell yr/yr to RMB7.86 bln
Material uncertainty over control of key subsidiary resolved during period
Fullshare expects sufficient working capital for operations and obligations over the next 12 months
NEW ENERGY SALES DROP - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to lower sales of gear products in new energy segment
IMPAIRMENT LOSSES - Higher impairment losses on financial assets and financial guarantee contracts weighed on profitability
HIGHER EXPENSES - Increased administrative and R&D expenses contributed to net loss
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 27 three months ago
